role: Chairman, Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission
stance_basis: statement read on his behalf endorsing Alternate #5 as least disruptive with minimal adverse environmental impacts
summary: Gordon A. King, Chairman of the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission, submitted a statement (read by Roy Gardetto) expressing support for the Airport Spur project, specifically endorsing Alternate #5 as offering the least disruptive connection to the airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts. The Commission had participated in the development of the Airport Spur, lending institutional backing to the project.
complaint_summary: Gordon A. King's statement, read by Roy Gardetto, indicated that the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission participated in developing the Airport Spur and that Alternate #5 appears to offer the least disruptive connection to the airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
